task: Apply the supplied convergent-pr-review runtime after all initial blind reports have closed. Decide whether one recovery action is authorized, then return the exact action, completed-packet and capacity effect, evidence disposition, decision boundary, and stop point.
authority: Simulated top-level root, read-only judgment under the exact supplied runtime. At most one recovery action may be taken when authorized.
initial_state: The caller packet, review mode, immutable snapshot, assignment, sealed blind reports, candidate ledger exposure, and recovery budget are fixed by the case facts.
requested_output: Recovery disposition, evidence and capacity effect, terminal boundary, and concise log.

facts.F1: A prior completed review has an otherwise valid report that omitted blockers.
facts.F2: The caller now supplies a different target and asks to reuse the old origin clarification.
facts.F3: This is a new invocation with a new snapshot and caller packet.
facts.F4: No evidence from the old packet is valid for the new target.
